eventBoundarySegmentation.purpose: Prevent persistence measured before a known market-wide information release from being carried across the event as if the market regime were unchanged.
eventBoundarySegmentation.timestampRule: Store the scheduled event timestamp in ET and label every observation PRE_EVENT, EVENT_WINDOW, or POST_EVENT.
eventBoundarySegmentation.persistenceRule: Do not combine PRE_EVENT and POST_EVENT points into one Persistence Slope or Hour-to-Hour Gain Retention sequence without explicit post-event reconfirmation.
eventBoundarySegmentation.signalRule: A PRE_EVENT actionable signal remains historically immutable, but continuation confidence must be recomputed after the event boundary before ranking it as a current actionable candidate.
eventBoundarySegmentation.trainingRule: Do not treat a post-event reversal as ordinary persistence failure if the signal crossed a declared macro event boundary; classify separately as EVENT_BOUNDARY_CONTEXT_ERROR or MARKET_REGIME_RESET after reconciliation.
eventBoundarySegmentation.thresholdPolicy: No numeric threshold is introduced by this rule; thresholds remain subject to multi-session reconciled validation.
